notes.title: Early Access v9
notes.content:
Bugfix
- The Fireball augment's AOE damage now gives the kill-credit to the caster
- Fixed typo in the discord message for the Purite Meteor spawn random event
- Dropping any compost will now give you the bucket instead

Feature
- Refactored the entire player task / town-rep system
- Item stat rolls now scale higher with the higher level tier they are
- Mob droptable's now contain gold coins
- Current Hunting Task UI window is now able to be moved
- You can now re-craft the "Holy Sting" quest item with Priest Paul once the quest has been completed

Misc
- The item stat roll "HP Regen per second" can only roll up to 1 (for now, will change later)
- General Stores will not buy any items now
- Changed Purite Meteor random event spawn chance 7% -> 4%
- Default amount of bank slots 300 -> 200
- Map is now disabled when inside any dungeon
- NPC shops do not sell any material items anymore

- Wiped all gold + items from everyone
- Updated Thornwood Log item sprite

notes.title: Early Access v3
notes.content:
Bugfix
- `Fixed typo in drop item warning text: destory -> destroy`
- `Changed lavite ore experience 564 -> 96`
- `Fixed both Airedale Swamp entrance exploits`
- `Lockpicks now work on opening chests/coffins`
- `Removed TrueDamage on mob damages if the mob requires an equipment to deal damage to (Ghosts, Count Merkin, etc.)`
- `Farmer Hat item is now not bugged`
- `Zombie Head item is now not bugged`
- `Temporarily removed Goblin Dungeon hole entrance (will need to refactor it with new dungeon system)`

Feature

- `Global Market for all players to buy + sell items to each other`

Misc
- `Angry Farmers now drop farming seeds`
- `Changed combat requirement for "Knights of Rockchester": 8 -> 15`
- `Changed Airedale Swamp Key rarity: Common -> Rare`
- `Changed the Bone Broth recipe: 2 Bone -> 3 Bone Fragments`
- `Changed Purite Ore rarity: Common -> Exotic`
- `Changed Purite Shards rarity: Common -> Exotic`
- `In the player-trading ui, it now shows the player's name you are trading with`
- `Changed Mystic Berries respawn time: 300s -> 60s`
